note: The bandwidth bound is ANALYTICAL, not measured. It uses the retail bandwidth cost proxy ($0.05/GB) from model-spec.json v2.1.0. Real node bandwidth bills are mostly flat-rate/unmetered, so this is an upper-bound economic proxy. No propagation delay data exists in the repository — block_interval.json contains block production intervals, not network propagation delays between nodes. A measured bound would require per-node propagation timing measurements (e.g., using the Bitcoin Core getnetworkinfo + timestamp-based propagation tests).

parameters.cost_per_gb_basis: Retail proxy ($0.05/GB) — NOT measured; real node bills are flat-rate/unmetered

comparison_to_storage.note: Bandwidth cost is a small fraction of total storage cost per block.
